en: Sārammaṇaduka (The Pair on Having an Object)
Dependent on a state with an object (*sārammaṇa*), a state without an object (*na-sārammaṇa*) arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*) … three.
Dependent on a state without an object (*anārammaṇa*), a state without an object arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state both with and without an object, a state without an object arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root-cause, nine; in the case of object, three; in the case of predominance, five ... [and so on] ... in the case of mutuality, six ... [and so on] ... in the case of prenascence and repetition, one ... [and so on] ... in the case of non-disappearance, nine. (The full detail applies in all cases.)
